1993. Balanced Symbols Checker

90

Hard

Problem Statement

Given a string containing round, curly, and square brackets, determine whether all the brackets are balanced and correctly nested using a stack.

Description

Read a string made up of the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']'. Use a stack to verify that every closing bracket matches the type of the most recently seen unmatched opening bracket, and that all brackets are properly nested.
input_spec: A single line containing a string s (1 ≤ length of s ≤ 100) made up only of the characters ( ) { } [ ].
output_spec: Print "Balanced" if all brackets are correctly matched and nested, otherwise print "Not Balanced".
